entities.name: Franz Ernst Brückmann

entities.summary: Franz Ernst Brückmann was a German mineralogist born at Marienthal near Helmstedt. Having qualified as a physician in 1721, he practised at Braunschweig and afterwards at Wolfenbüttel. In 1747 he was appointed medical assessor in Braunschweig.

entities.summary: Franz Ernst Brückmann was a German mineralogist born at Marienthal near Helmstedt. Having qualified as a physician in 1721, he practised at Braunschweig and afterwards at Wolfenbüttel. In 1747 he was appointed medical assessor in Braunschweig.
